style_when: the article is a purely conceptual synthesis or policy dilemma where no physical facility, machine, or supply chain exists, and an elegant abstract paper silhouette states the idea. Never reach for paper collage when the story describes physical manufacturing, freight, energy, hardware, or heavy infrastructure — use cinematic still or telephoto industry instead
prompt: Minimalist editorial cut-paper collage resting on a real dark wooden table. Three stylized cut-paper object silhouettes: a central locked document folder, a sharp crimson arrow sliding out silently from beneath the folder, and an open gateway shape. Hand-torn rag paper with visible fibre and halftone newsprint texture. Deep physical cast shadows under each overlapping paper layer. One raking directional key light, muted modern editorial palette of charcoal, cream, and deep red, crisp clean edges, generous negative space. Extreme asymmetry with the paper elements positioned off-centre on the right.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, typography, fonts
rationale: Paper collage elegantly captures the abstract, systemic nature of a governance policy failure and data exfiltration path, using minimalist silhouettes to represent the bypassed boundaries without resorting to literal or cliché server racks.
subject: a stylized cut-paper silhouette of a document folder with a hidden egress arrow
core_thesis: The September 2026 record shows agent governance failing on the data path, not the actor.
core_conflict: Identity-scoped agent permissions versus unmonitored stealth data egress pathways.
